Independent work / Document intelligence

Smart Procurement ERP Logging System

A document-to-ERP prototype for turning bills, receipts and invoices into structured procurement records with confidence-based review gates.

Status
Functional prototype · Development completed
Context
Self-employed · Independent prototype
My role
Independent prototype development

Independent functional prototype, with completed development and ERP integration tested against Odoo references.

01 / Context

The problem

Logging procurement documents into enterprise ERP systems involves repetitive manual reading and data entry. The prototype explores a connected workflow from document ingestion and extraction to review and ERP integration.

My contribution

Independent prototype development spanning document ingestion, multimodal extraction, backend workflow design and ERP adapter integration.

02 / Workflow

From input to outcome

  1. Receive documents

    Upload APIs, email inbox watchers and external payloads.

  2. Apply ingestion controls

    Hash deduplication, antivirus scanning and quarantine.

  3. Extract document structure

    PaddleOCR and an 8-bit quantized 8B vision-language model.

  4. Evaluate and review

    Deterministic fallback filters, confidence scoring and manual review gates.

  5. Integrate with an ERP

    A ProcurementERP port and adapters; tested against Odoo references.

03 / Architecture

Implementation boundaries

API and validation

Python, FastAPI and Pydantic form the backend and validation layer.

Document intelligence

PaddleOCR is paired with an 8-bit quantized 8B VLM for multimodal layout extraction.

Persistence and retrieval

PostgreSQL combines pgvector with full-text search. MinIO/S3 object storage holds document assets.

Workflow and integration

Temporal workflows coordinate processing. The ProcurementERP port separates the workflow from target-specific ERP adapters.

  • Python

04 / Engineering decisions

Controls and trade-offs

Separate extraction from acceptance

Model output is checked with confidence scoring and deterministic backend fallback filters. Unverified or low-confidence extractions go through human review gates.

Make the ERP boundary explicit

The adapter pattern keeps target-specific ERP communication behind the ProcurementERP port. Odoo references were used for integration testing.

Combine OCR with visual-language extraction

PaddleOCR is paired with an 8-bit quantized 8B VLM for multimodal layout extraction. The model configuration is explicit so future evaluation can be tied to a reproducible setup.

05 / Status and evidence

Current result and validation boundary

A functional prototype with completed development and reference-based ERP integration testing. Extraction quality, review rate, processing latency and cost per document remain unpublished in this case study.
